reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29 against the Accountable reserves_split replay captured 2026-08-28: the existing adapter emitted the exact unkeyed names Base (52.6%), Ethereum (34.9%), Avalanche (12.4%), and Copper (0.1%). These are location/custody or settlement buckets, not asset classes, so every row is conservatively classified as assetClass other and uses the same YieldPoint (XSY) managed-strategy and undisclosed custody/venue-counterparty failure domain. YieldPoint's current flow documentation says USDC is minted 1:1 and swept to a custodian, while XSY's public mechanics describe strategy modules and give long-spot/short-perpetuals only as examples; the sources do not publish the current strategy assets, retained USDC, hedge notionals, margin, venue balances, custody-provider shares, or liquidation buffers. No UTY sourceKeyMap is configured, so the reviewed rows intentionally match the live names exactly and do not imply asset-level itemization.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable reserves_split location/custody snapshot captured 2026-08-28 and normalized by the existing one-decimal live adapter, interpreted with current XSY/YieldPoint flow, strategy, and risk disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 100% figure reflects that all four published Accountable location envelopes remain unitemized at asset level and are therefore unresolved for reserve composition; it does not assert that the managed strategy is absent. XSY and Accountable do not itemize the strategy's retained USDC, long/short positions, margin, venue balances, custody-provider allocation, or liquidation buffers within any location bucket.
